title: Organic food no more nutritious than conventionally grown food - Harvard Health
summary: Harvard Health summary of a Stanford review: organic food offers little nutritional advantage but has fewer pesticide residues and less antibiotic-resistant bacteria.

assertions.quote: nutritionally speaking they have little extra to offer
a higher omega-3 fatty acid content in organic milk and chicken
Organic produce did have the slight edge in food safety, with 30% lower pesticide residues
Organic chicken and pork were also about a third less likely to contain antibiotic-resistant bacteria
the bacteria that cause food poisoning were equally present in both types of foods

verdicts.note: Systematic reviews find no consistent difference in pathogen contamination between organic and conventional foods.

assertions.quote: Organic foods are more expensive—and often significantly more so—than non-organic.
These foods might be worth buying organic
